intents.response: If your rights are violated, you can file a complaint through the RightsInsight Portal. Go to the Complaint section, fill in details, upload evidence, and submit it. You can track its status in 'My Complaints'.
You can upload documents or images as evidence while submitting a complaint.

patterns: how can I see my complaints status
intents.response: To check your complaint status: Login to your account, go to 'My Complaints', view your complaints, and check status (Pending / Approved / Rejected).
